mapper.sql: m.mapping_id as MAPPING_ID, m.period_id as PERIOD_ID, m.evaluatee_id as EVALUATEE_ID, m.evaluator_id as EVALUATOR_ID, m.relation_type_code as RELATION_TYPE_CODE, e1.name as EVALUATEE_NAME, e2.name as EVALUATOR_NAME, m.is_deleted as IS_DELETED, m.version as VERSION, m.created_at as CREATED_AT, m.created_by as CREATED_BY, m.updated_at as UPDATED_AT, m.updated_by as UPDATED_BY
from evaluator_mappings_51 m inner join employees_51 e1 on m.evaluatee_id = e1.emp_id inner join employees_51 e2 on m.evaluator_id = e2.emp_id
left join departments_51 d on e1.dept_id = d.dept_id and d.is_deleted = 'n' left join positions_51 p on e1.position_id = p.position_id and p.is_deleted = 'n'
mapper.select:
select , p.position_name as TITLE_NAME
where m.mapping_id = #{mappingId} and m.is_deleted = 'n'

select , d.dept_name as DEPT_NAME, p.position_name as TITLE_NAME
where m.period_id = #{periodId} and m.is_deleted = 'n'
and e1.dept_id = #{deptId} and e1.is_deleted = 'n'
and ( e1.name like '%' + #{empName} + '%'
or e1.emp_id = CAST(#{empName} AS BIGINT)
)
order by m.evaluatee_id asc, m.relation_type_code asc

select , d.dept_name as DEPT_NAME, p.position_name as TITLE_NAME
and m.period_id = #{periodId}
and m.evaluatee_id = #{evaluateeId} and m.is_deleted = 'n' and e1.status_code = 'EMPLOYED'
order by m.relation_type_code asc, m.evaluator_id asc
mapper.delete: update evaluator_mappings_51 set is_deleted = 'y', updated_at = GETDATE(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} where period_id = #{periodId} and relation_type_code = 'SELF' and is_deleted = 'n'
mapper.update:
update evaluator_mappings_51 set is_deleted = 'y', updated_at = #{updatedAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} where period_id = #{periodId} and is_deleted = 'n'
and evaluatee_id in (select emp_id from employees_51 where dept_id = #{deptId})
mapper.select:
select mapping_id as MAPPING_ID, period_id as PERIOD_ID, evaluatee_id as EVALUATEE_ID, evaluator_id as EVALUATOR_ID, relation_type_code as RELATION_TYPE_CODE, is_deleted as IS_DELETED from evaluator_mappings_51 where is_deleted = 'n'
and period_id = #{periodId}

select , ep.period_name as PERIOD_NAME, d.dept_name as DEPT_NAME, p.position_name as TITLE_NAME, ep.period_year as PERIOD_YEAR
inner join evaluation_periods_51 ep on m.period_id = ep.period_id
and m.period_id = #{periodId}
and m.relation_type_code = #{relationTypeCode} and m.is_deleted = 'n' and ep.is_deleted = 'n' and ep.status_code != 'PLANNED' and e1.status_code = 'EMPLOYED'
order by ep.start_date desc, d.dept_name asc, e1.name asc

select distinct e1.emp_id as evaluateeId, e1.name as evaluateeName, coalesce(d.dept_name, '알 수 없음') as deptName, 'RETIRED_EVALUATOR' as anomalyType, '매핑된 ' + m.relation_type_code + ' 평가자(' + e2.name + ')가 퇴사 상태입니다.' as description, 'INFO' as severity from evaluator_mappings_51 m inner join employees_51 e1 on m.evaluatee_id = e1.emp_id inner join employees_51 e2 on m.evaluator_id = e2.emp_id left join departments_51 d on e1.dept_id = d.dept_id where m.period_id = #{periodId} and m.is_deleted = 'n' and e1.status_code = 'EMPLOYED' and e2.status_code != 'EMPLOYED'

select e.emp_id as evaluateeId, e.name as evaluateeName, coalesce(d.dept_name, '알 수 없음') as deptName, 'MISSING_SELF' as anomalyType, '본인 평가 매핑이 누락되었습니다.' as description, 'ERROR' as severity from employees_51 e left join departments_51 d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id where e.status_code = 'EMPLOYED' and not exists ( select 1 from employee_roles_51 er inner join roles_51 r on er.role_id = r.role_id where er.emp_id = e.emp_id and r.role_name in ('ROLE_EXECUTIVE', 'ROLE_ADMIN') ) and not exists ( select 1 from evaluator_mappings_51 m where m.evaluatee_id = e.emp_id and m.relation_type_code = 'SELF' and m.period_id = #{periodId} and m.is_deleted = 'n' )

select e.emp_id as evaluateeId, e.name as evaluateeName, coalesce(d.dept_name, '알 수 없음') as deptName, 'MISSING_MANAGER' as anomalyType, case when e.dept_id is null then '부서가 미배정 상태이며, 1차 평가자(부서장) 매핑이 누락되었습니다.' when d.leader_id is null then '부서장 미지정 (임원 평가 대체)' when leader_emp.status_code != 'EMPLOYED' then '부서장 퇴사 (임원 평가 대체)' else '1차 평가자(부서장) 매핑이 누락되었습니다.' end as description, case when e.dept_id is null then 'INFO' when d.leader_id is null then 'INFO' when leader_emp.status_code != 'EMPLOYED' then 'INFO' else 'WARNING' end as severity from employees_51 e left join departments_51 d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id left join employees_51 leader_emp on d.leader_id = leader_emp.emp_id where e.status_code = 'EMPLOYED' and not exists ( select 1 from employee_roles_51 er inner join roles_51 r on er.role_id = r.role_id where er.emp_id = e.emp_id and r.role_name in ('ROLE_EXECUTIVE', 'ROLE_ADMIN') ) and ( e.dept_id is null or d.leader_id is null or e.emp_id != d.leader_id or leader_emp.status_code != 'EMPLOYED' ) and not exists ( select 1 from evaluator_mappings_51 m where m.evaluatee_id = e.emp_id and m.relation_type_code = 'MANAGER' and m.period_id = #{periodId} and m.is_deleted = 'n' )

select e.emp_id as evaluateeId, e.name as evaluateeName, coalesce(d.dept_name, '알 수 없음') as deptName, 'MISSING_SUBORDINATE' as anomalyType, '다면 평가자(부서원) 매핑이 0명입니다.' as description, 'WARNING' as severity from employees_51 e inner join departments_51 d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id where e.status_code = 'EMPLOYED' and e.emp_id = d.leader_id and not exists ( select 1 from employee_roles_51 er inner join roles_51 r on er.role_id = r.role_id where er.emp_id = e.emp_id and r.role_name in ('ROLE_EXECUTIVE', 'ROLE_ADMIN') ) and not exists ( select 1 from evaluator_mappings_51 m where m.evaluatee_id = e.emp_id and m.relation_type_code = 'SUBORDINATE' and m.period_id = #{periodId} and m.is_deleted = 'n' )

select e.emp_id as evaluateeId, e.name as evaluateeName, coalesce(d.dept_name, '알 수 없음') as deptName, 'MISSING_EXECUTIVE' as anomalyType, '최종 평가자(임원) 매핑이 누락되었습니다.' as description, 'ERROR' as severity from employees_51 e left join departments_51 d on e.dept_id = d.dept_id where e.status_code = 'EMPLOYED' and not exists ( select 1 from employee_roles_51 er inner join roles_51 r on er.role_id = r.role_id where er.emp_id = e.emp_id and r.role_name in ('ROLE_EXECUTIVE', 'ROLE_ADMIN') ) and not exists ( select 1 from evaluator_mappings_51 m where m.evaluatee_id = e.emp_id and m.relation_type_code = 'EXECUTIVE' and m.period_id = #{periodId} and m.is_deleted = 'n' )
